brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a moot is someone you follow that follows you. The date the last person followed is the mootiversary. site where you enter your handle it returns your list of moots in a github style heatmap. the squares denoting a mootiversary should be blue and on hover returns handle and date
note: mootiversary: enter a handle, get your moots as a GitHub-style heatmap — blue squares are mootiversaries (the later follow's date); hover for handle + date.
